questions.question: Why was a man named Elihu burning with anger against Job?

answers.text: Job justified himself rather than God
Job spoke before the older men
Job ignored all of Elihu's advice

questions.question: Why did Elihu wait to speak to Job and his three friends?

answers.text: The other men were older than he
The other men were richer than he
The other men were stronger than he
